primary: Per-query one-to-one event F1 at IoU .5: event rescue minus whole-answer medoid on multi. Single events are a harm check. Offline and new OMTG inference stay separate.
controls: First draw, whole-answer event-F1 medoid, timeline majority >=4/8, same number of extra disjoint events without using support, greedy on OMTG.
rule: From the medoid add at most two disjoint events; median endpoints of spans with IoU >=.5; at least 3 different answers must support final span. Prefer higher support then mean matched IoU.
decision: Advance if offline multi gains >=2 pp, paired 95% lower bound >0, single loss <=1 pp and fresh OMTG points in same direction. Otherwise identify bottleneck; no tuning.
resource: GPU 2+7; per device NVML process limit 6144 MiB, torch 5632 MiB, minimum free 2560 MiB.
